id.description: A unique identifier for the pack. Usually assigned by the server.

default.description: If this pack is installed by default with a fresh install of mechvibes. Readonly property set by the server.

key_define_type.description: The type of key defines used in this soundpack.

defines.description: The key definitions for this soundpack.

$index.description: The keycode to define. Use iohook's keycodes.

$value.description: Information about the sound to play when the key is pressed.

mode.description: The play mode of the sound.

files.$comment: Use only one file in single mode
files.description: The files that can play when the key is pressed.

clips.description: The clips that can play when the key is pressed. [start,end] format.

tags.description: Tags to help users find this soundpack.

properties.$comment: There may be additional properties which are set by the server, which are for information only and not used by the app.
